tasks.label: Dev Build
tasks.command: w64devkit\bin\windres.exe resources.rc -o resources.o && w64devkit\bin\gcc.exe *.c source/*.c screens/*.c resources.o -o "${input:exeName}_dev.exe" -I headers -I ./lib/raylib6/include -L ./lib/raylib6/lib -O2 -lraylib -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm && ".\${input:exeName}_dev.exe"

tasks.label: Release Build
tasks.command: w64devkit\bin\windres.exe resources.rc -o resources.o && w64devkit\bin\gcc.exe *.c source/*.c screens/*.c resources.o -o "${input:exeName}.exe" -O2 -s -static -I headers -I ./lib/raylib6/include -L ./lib/raylib6/lib -lraylib -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -mwindows && ".\${input:exeName}.exe"
